all_views_geometry.mask_background: 13-sample action-window temporal median, except the true empty view18 reference for view19
all_views_geometry.caveat: Candidate masks, not semantic ground truth. Centers are silhouette centroids, not corresponding physical keypoints. Visual hull is a silhouette-derived volume, not measured surface points. Shared cameras and timing remain estimated.

box_feasibility.box_method: Largest-component bounds expanded by eight pixels, except manually reviewed generous view07/view11 boxes
box_feasibility.criterion: One 3D point must project inside every bounding box with positive depth. Necessary for a common board point, not sufficient for a correct surface.
box_feasibility.limitations: Numerical LP on approximate observations and estimated cameras, not proof of physical impossibility. Coarse silhouettes, residual timing, calibration and replay consistency remain possible explanations.

timing_hypothesis.caution: Single-instant centroid alignment hypothesis. Masks and silhouette centroids are approximate. Not proof of full-sequence synchronization; requires visual review and geometric recheck.

independent_focals.method: Same background images/masks and extraction settings, separate SIMPLE_PINHOLE focal per image; principal point fixed; training views only
independent_focals.caveat: Sensitivity analysis, not independent calibration ground truth. More parameters may overfit.

verdict: Board recognizable in inspected training views of unrestricted static fit, but reserved view20 remains poor. Appearance-only fixed geometry does not resolve novel-view quality. Restricted static feasibility, no successful 4D reconstruction or tracking.
limitations: Masks approximate, some incomplete. Excluded07/08/09 still contributed to inherited17-view background map and background seed cloud. Multiple factors change relative to prior dynamic runs. Fixed control also changes SH degree and densification, so it does not isolate position drift.
